photos.name: Mercedes Road
photos.safeNote: Narrow, winding, tree-lined residential road with light traffic and smooth pavement; no bike lane but low stress.
photos.greenNote: Narrow road tunnels under a dense canopy of mature trees, with leafy understory and wooded hillside beside it.

photos.name: Prospect Road
photos.safeNote: Quiet 25 mph wooded road with no centre-line traffic, but cracked pavement and narrow edges need care.
photos.greenNote: Oak canopy closes completely over a narrow road with dense understory and riparian-style vegetation, no buildings or traffic in view.

photos.name: Regnart Road
photos.safeNote: Quiet 25 mph rural-residential road with light traffic and no parked cars; comfortable for cautious riders despite narrow edges.
photos.greenNote: Oak canopy closes over a winding hillside road with dense woodland on both sides, very leafy and natural.

photos.name: Stevens Canyon Road
photos.safeNote: Winding rural canyon road with no bike lane and limited sight lines, though speeds are moderate and traffic light.
photos.greenNote: Dense chaparral and oak woodland line the road on rolling hills, with no buildings or traffic in view.

photos.name: McClellan Road
photos.safeNote: Quiet tree-lined residential street at 25 mph with a centre line and no parking; shared-lane markings only.
photos.greenNote: Tall mature trees arch over McClellan Road, with a grassy open space and lush roadside planting along the curb.

photos.name: Lindy Lane
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential hill street with no bike lane, light traffic, and some cracked pavement and limited sight lines.
photos.greenNote: Dense mature oaks form a closed canopy over a hillside lane, with lush roadside vegetation and no buildings dominating the view.

photos.name: Deodara Drive
photos.safeNote: Quiet, low-speed residential street with clear sight lines and good pavement; comfortable for most riders.
photos.greenNote: Tall trees and dense shrubs line both sides, with canopy closing over the quiet residential road.

photos.name: Regnart Canyon Drive
photos.safeNote: Narrow, quiet, shaded canyon road with good pavement and clear sight lines; no bike lane but low traffic.
photos.greenNote: Dense oak canopy closes over a shaded canyon road with lush planting and nearby creek-side vegetation.

photos.name: Cristo Rey Drive
photos.safeNote: Two-lane 30 mph road with a centre line and no bike lane, but a clear, smooth pavement and quiet traffic.
photos.greenNote: Dense eucalyptus and shrubs line a bridge over a creek corridor, with tree crowns overhanging the road and little built clutter.

photos.name: Blue Hills Lane
photos.safeNote: Narrow, quiet rural residential lane with good pavement and clear sight lines; low traffic expected.
photos.greenNote: Narrow lane under closed oak canopy with dense shrubs and hillside vegetation; very natural, though a vehicle hood fills the lower view.

photos.name: Heney Creek Place
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential cul-de-sac-style street with light traffic; just watch cracked pavement and parked bins.
photos.greenNote: Dense mature trees and shrubs line the road with creek-side vegetation; canopy partly covers the sky, though photo is winter-dated.

photos.name: nan
photos.safeNote: Narrow, tree-lined residential lane with no bike lane and some cracked pavement; sight lines are partly blocked by vegetation.
photos.greenNote: Narrow lane is enclosed by a full canopy of mature trees and dense ivy-covered banks, with leaves on..

photos.name: Ricardo Road
photos.safeNote: Quiet, shaded residential street with good pavement and clear sight lines; no bike lane, but traffic is light.
photos.greenNote: Mature oaks form a closed canopy over a quiet residential road with leafy yards on both sides.

photos.name: North Foothill Boulevard
photos.safeNote: Mapped bike lane on a 40 mph road; curb side mostly out of view, so score is tentative.
photos.greenNote: Mature pines and dense oaks line the road with lush roadside planting and hillside vegetation nearby.

photos.name: Mira Vista Road
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with shared-lane markings only; lightly trafficked and easy to ride, but no dedicated lane.
photos.greenNote: Residential street with mature trees and lush shrubs on both sides; canopy partly closes over the road.

photos.name: Vineyard Court
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential court with light traffic and good pavement; no bike lane, but a low-stress ride.
photos.greenNote: Quiet residential court with mature trees and lush front yards; canopy overhangs the road in places.

photos.name: Cozette Lane
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with shade trees and light traffic; no bike lane, but low speeds make riding comfortable.
photos.greenNote: Residential street with mature trees on both sides forming a largely closed canopy over the road.

photos.name: South Tantau Avenue
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street at 25 mph with shared-lane markings only; driveways add some conflicts but traffic is light.
photos.greenNote: Residential street with mature trees on both sides and a largely closed canopy over the road.

photos.name: Pacifica Drive
photos.safeNote: Quiet 25 mph residential street with wide lanes and clear sight lines; shared-lane markings only.
photos.greenNote: Residential street with mature trees and lawn park on one side; canopy partly closes overhead, with a green corridor nearby.

photos.name: Twig Lane
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with light traffic and parked vehicles; no bike lane but low speeds, so easy riding.
photos.greenNote: Residential street with mature trees on both sides forming a largely closed canopy over the road.

photos.name: Stevens Creek Boulevard
photos.safeNote: Stevens Creek Boulevard at 40 mph with 4-5 lanes under an overpass; a stressful, hard-to-ride corridor.
photos.greenNote: Route passes beneath a freeway overpass; concrete pillars and pavement dominate, with no trees or planting visible.

photos.name: Lawrence Expressway
photos.safeNote: Four-lane expressway at 50 mph with no real bike lane; shared lane is unsafe for ordinary riders.
photos.greenNote: Route runs under a concrete freeway overpass with no trees or planting, only pavement, pillars and bare embankment.

photos.name: Marigny Place
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with slow traffic and no bike lane; parked cars and driveways add some caution.
photos.greenNote: Townhome street with paved frontages, parked cars and garages; only sparse small shrubs, no trees over the road.

photos.name: North Blaney Avenue
photos.safeNote: Bridge over freeway with a mapped bike lane, but the photos don't show a clear lane and pavement is potholed.
photos.greenNote: Bridge over a freeway with chain-link railings; the little vegetation shown is distant or beside the freeway, not street greenery.

photos.name: South De Anza Boulevard
photos.safeNote: Painted lane beside 40 mph traffic and parked cars, with faded markings and cracked pavement; stressful for most riders.
photos.greenNote: Wide arterial with paved lanes and parked cars; only scattered trees and a fence-side hedge are visible.

photos.name: Bark Lane
photos.safeNote: No bike lane and a busy commercial frontage with many driveways; speed and lane count are unmapped.
photos.greenNote: Commercial intersection with strip retail and pavement; only a few scattered trees and small planting areas.

photos.name: Covina Court
photos.safeNote: Quiet one-way residential court with clear sight lines and good pavement; no bike lane needed at low traffic.
photos.greenNote: Bare dirt strip, a few shrubs and one palm; fences and buildings dominate, with almost no canopy over the street.

photos.name: North De Anza Boulevard
photos.safeNote: Fast multi-lane arterial at 40 mph with a buffered lane, but the photos show no bike lane clearly.
photos.greenNote: Wide multi-lane arterial with pavement and fencing; only scattered trees on the edges, little canopy over the road.

photos.name: Sharon Drive
photos.safeNote: Quiet 25 mph residential street with wide, smooth pavement and clear sight lines; easy riding.
photos.greenNote: Commercial-style street with modern buildings, parked cars and pavement; only a few small trees and shrubs.

photos.name: Stern Avenue
photos.safeNote: Quiet 25 mph street with no bike lane and some parked cars, plus cracked pavement at the edge.
photos.greenNote: Mostly pavement, glass office buildings and parked cars; only a few scattered trees on the left.

photos.name: Vallco Parkway
photos.safeNote: Mapped bike lane beside a one-way four-lane arterial at 35 mph with a right-turn lane; curb side mostly out of view.
photos.greenNote: Wide commercial street with a parking garage and apartments; only a few small trees and a planted island.

photos.name: South Bernardo Avenue
photos.safeNote: Quiet 30 mph two-lane street with no bike lane but light traffic and good pavement; a comfortable ride for most.
photos.greenNote: Mostly a blank concrete wall, pavement and buildings, with only a few scattered trees and no real canopy.

photos.name: Loma Linda Drive
photos.safeNote: Multi-lane arterial-style road with no bike lane, many driveways and parked cars; speed limit unmapped.
photos.greenNote: Wide road with parking lots and commercial buildings; only a few scattered young trees and little planting.

photos.name: Saratoga-Sunnyvale Road
photos.safeNote: Painted lane at 40 mph with many driveways and cracked pavement; uncomfortable for cautious riders.
photos.greenNote: Commercial strip with bare winter trees, parking lots and pavement dominate; only sparse young trees and small planting beds.

photos.name: Rodrigues Avenue
photos.safeNote: Low-speed residential-edge road with sharrows only; many driveways and parking reduce comfort, but traffic is light.
photos.greenNote: Commercial strip with parking lots and a few sparse young trees; little canopy or planting visible.

photos.name: Kentwood Avenue
photos.safeNote: Photo shows a wide, open commercial intersection rather than the residential road point; curb side and bike lane are not visible.
photos.greenNote: Wide intersection with a McDonald's, parking lots and pavement; only a few scattered trees and small planters.

photos.name: Bianchini Lane
photos.safeNote: Quiet narrow residential lane with light traffic and smooth pavement; parked cars and driveways need care.
photos.greenNote: Narrow lane between townhouse blocks; one bare tree and a few shrubs, little greenery in view.

photos.name: Murano Circle
photos.safeNote: Quiet private-feeling residential court with brick paving and light traffic; many garage driveways but slow, low-speed riding.
photos.greenNote: Brick-paved townhouse lane with a few small shrubs and one distant tree; mostly hardscape and garages.

photos.name: Wolfe Road
photos.safeNote: Wide signalised arterial with a right-turn lane, pothole patches and a long crossing; bike lane exists but is partly unclear.
photos.greenNote: Wide crossing with pavement, signals and a construction fence; only a few scattered trees and gravel medians.

photos.name: North Tantau Avenue
photos.safeNote: Bridge deck with no visible bike lane; mapped painted lanes at 30 mph on a 4-5 lane road rate moderate stress.
photos.greenNote: Overpass with concrete barriers and fencing; a few trees at edges, freeway and parking lots in view.

photos.name: Alpine Drive
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with no bike lane, but construction cones and a large pothole narrow the usable riding space.
photos.greenNote: Tree-lined residential street with mature trees and lush planting on both sides, though construction cones and a parked truck partly block the view.

photos.name: Cabot Avenue
photos.safeNote: Painted bike lane on a two-lane-each-way road with moderate traffic; the curb-side lane is narrow, so ride with caution.
photos.greenNote: Wide commercial corridor with mostly pavement and buildings; only a few scattered trees and small planted strips.

photos.name: Hale Place
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with light traffic and clear sight lines; parked cars and driveways are the main concerns.
photos.greenNote: Residential street with a few young trees and some hedges, but no canopy over the road and mostly pavement.

photos.name: Gardena Drive
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with 25 mph limit, light traffic, good pavement and clear sight lines.
photos.greenNote: Residential street with street trees on the right and some front-yard planting, but canopy over the road is only partial.

photos.name: Forest Avenue
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with 25 mph sign and parked cars; shared-lane markings only, so ride carefully near doors.
photos.greenNote: Residential street with mature trees along both sides and some canopy, though gaps and parked cars reduce the green feel.

photos.name: Toni Court
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential court with slow traffic and clear sight lines; no bike lane but very low stress.
photos.greenNote: Suburban cul-de-sac with lawns, shrubs and a few young trees, but little canopy over the road.

photos.name: Plum Tree Lane
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with light traffic and no bike lane; parked cars and some cracked pavement, but manageable.
photos.greenNote: Tree-lined residential street with mature trees on both sides, though canopy has gaps and a parked car partly blocks the view.

photos.name: Randy Lane
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with no bike lane, light traffic and good pavement; driveways are the main concern.
photos.greenNote: Residential street with mature trees and shrubs on both sides, but canopy is only partial and the sky is largely open.

photos.name: Vista Drive
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with wide edge space and clear sight lines; no bike lane, but low traffic and speed.
photos.greenNote: Tree-lined residential street with a park edge and shrub planting; canopy has gaps over the road.

photos.name: Lazaneo Drive
photos.safeNote: Quiet two-lane residential street with clear sightlines and good pavement, but no bike lane and unknown speed limit.
photos.greenNote: Residential street with a few mature trees and hedges on one side, but mostly open road and industrial buildings.

photos.name: Anne Lane
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with light traffic and clear sight lines; no bike lane but very low stress.
photos.greenNote: Tree-lined residential lane with mature trees and a palm, though canopy gaps leave the road partly open to sky.

photos.name: Baxter Avenue
photos.safeNote: Quiet 25 mph residential street with clear sight lines; cracked pavement is the main concern.
photos.greenNote: Residential street with some scattered trees and shrubs, but canopy over the road is thin and sky is mostly open.

photos.name: Mitty Way
photos.safeNote: Quiet two-lane residential street with clear sight lines; cracked pavement and no bike lane, but low traffic.
photos.greenNote: Some street trees line this residential road, but canopy is partial and the view is mostly pavement and buildings.

photos.name: Belleville Way
photos.safeNote: Quiet 25 mph residential street with clear sight lines and light traffic; parked cars are the main concern.
photos.greenNote: Mature street trees on one side and scattered shrubs, but canopy is partial and the view is mostly pavement and portable buildings.

photos.name: Alberta Avenue
photos.safeNote: Quiet 25 mph residential street with clear sight lines and good pavement; parked cars and driveways add some caution.
photos.greenNote: Mature street trees line one side and some front yards are planted, but canopy over the road is only partial.

photos.name: Whiteoak Drive
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with a good surface and clear sightlines; few cars, but many driveways and no bike lane.
photos.greenNote: Tree-lined residential street with mature trees and shrubs, though canopy has gaps over the road.

photos.name: West Homestead Road
photos.safeNote: Painted bike lane on a 35 mph four-to-five-lane arterial with many driveways and a narrow edge; stressful for cautious riders.
photos.greenNote: Mature trees line one side and frame the road, but the wide arterial and houses limit canopy overhead.

photos.name: Club House Lane
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with clear sight lines and good pavement; no bike lane, but traffic looks light.
photos.greenNote: Tall conifers and willows line the road, with a grassy open space on the left and planted front yards.

photos.name: Wunderlich Drive
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential street with good pavement and clear sight lines; no bike lane but low traffic stress.
photos.greenNote: Tree-lined residential street with mature trees on the right and gaps in the canopy overhead.

photos.name: Edminton Drive
photos.safeNote: Quiet residential cul-de-sac-style street with light traffic and clear sight lines; comfortable for careful riders.
photos.greenNote: Bare winter birch and shrubs line a curving residential street, but there is little canopy over the road.
